This examination, far from being a mere </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（仅仅；极小的） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>routine </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（常规） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>assessment of academic prowess </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（高超的技艺） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>, serves as a profound litmus test of one’s dedication, perseverance, and intellectual fortitude </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（是检验一个人的奉献精神、毅力和智力毅力的深刻试金石） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>. According to an exclusive revelation</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:2.8pt;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:-.75pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;line-height:90%><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（独家爆料） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>from the Academic Affairs Office of the Soil Grass, the difficulty level of this exam has been meticulously calibrated to strike a delicate balance between challenge and feasibility, ensuring that it neither overwhelms nor underwhelms the aspirational spirits of the student body </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（这次考试的难度经过了精心的调整，在挑战性和可行性之间取得了微妙的平衡，确保它既不会压倒也不会辜负学生的雄心壮志） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>. However, what truly sets this exam apart </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（让这次考试与众不同的） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>is the fiercely competitive </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（竞争激烈） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>nature of the race for the prestigious title </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（高级头衔） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>of grade-topper, a distinction that has become the subject of fervent speculation and heated debate among students and faculty alike. </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（这一区别已成为学生和教师热烈猜测和激烈辩论的主题。）</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:2.8pt;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:-.75pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;text-indent:27.45pt;line-height:90%><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>In a candid and rather magnanimous statement, Yu Zixuan, the reigning champion of the previous semester, remarked with a blend of humility and determination </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（在一份坦率而相当宽宏大量的声明中，上学期的获奖者谦逊而坚定地表示） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>, “I shall spare no effort in my quest to retain my position at the pinnacle of academic excellence. Nevertheless, it is my sincerest wish that my peers, too, rise to the occasion and unleash their full potential, for it is in the spirit of collective growth and mutual inspiration that true greatness is forged. </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（我将不遗余力地追求保持我在学术上的顶峰。然而，我衷心希望我的同龄人也能迎难而上，充分发挥潜力，因为正是本着集体成长和相互激励的精神，才能铸就真正的伟大。） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>” Such words, dripping with both competitive zeal and altruistic sentiment, have only served to heighten the anticipation surrounding this high-stakes academic showdown. ( </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>这些充满竞争热情和利他主义情绪的话语，只会加剧人们对这场高风险学术决战的期待。 </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>)</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:2.8pt;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:-.75pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;text-indent:27.45pt;line-height:90%><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>Lin Yuqing, a student who has a good result( </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>成绩）， </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>the front-runner </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（最有可能夺得年级第一者） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>,said “The key to achieving good grades is ‘ The conduct of a noble person is to cultivate oneself through tranquility and nurture virtue through frugality. Without indifference, one cannot clarify their aspirations; without serenity, one cannot achieve far-reaching goals. Learning requires calmness, and talent requires learning. Without learning, one cannot broaden their talents; without determination, one cannot accomplish their studies. Indulgence and laziness prevent one from striving diligently, while recklessness and impatience hinder the cultivation of character. As time passes, one's ambitions fade with the days, leading to a withered and fallen state, often disconnected from the world. To sadly dwell in poverty </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>— </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>what can be done then?’ “.( </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>诫子书）</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:2.8pt;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:-.75pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;text-indent:27.45pt;line-height:90%><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>In conclusion, as the countdown to the monthly exam ticks away with relentless inevitability, the air is thick with a palpable sense of urgency, ambition, and, dare I say, a touch of existential dread. Who will emerge victorious in this battle of wits and wills? Only time, that most impartial of arbiters, will tell. </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（总之，随着月考的倒计时不可避免地流逝，空气中弥漫着一种明显的紧迫感、雄心壮志，我敢说，还有一丝存在的恐惧。谁将在这场智慧和意志的较量中获胜？只有时间，最公正的仲裁者，会告诉我们答案。）</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:0;margin-bottom:3.3pt;margin-left:295.85pt><!--[if mso & !supportInlineShapes & supportFields]><span

examination of the semester </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（半学年） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>on the horizon </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（范围） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>, students across all grade levels have plunged themselves into </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（热情投入） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>an intense </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（紧张激烈的） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>and nerve-wracking phase </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（阶段） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>of revision </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（复习） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>, characterized by </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（表现为） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>sleepless nights, endless cups of coffee, and an atmosphere </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（气氛） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>thick </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（浓厚的） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>with academic tension </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（学术紧张） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>. This examination, far from being a mere </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（仅仅；极小的） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>routine </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（常规） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>assessment of academic prowess </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（高超的技艺） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>, serves as a profound litmus test of one’s dedication, perseverance, and intellectual fortitude </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（是检验一个人的奉献精神、毅力和智力毅力的深刻试金石） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>. According to an exclusive revelation</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:2.8pt;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:-.75pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;line-height:90%><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（独家爆料） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>from the Academic Affairs Office of the Soil Grass, the difficulty level of this exam has been meticulously calibrated to strike a delicate balance between challenge and feasibility, ensuring that it neither overwhelms nor underwhelms the aspirational spirits of the student body </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（这次考试的难度经过了精心的调整，在挑战性和可行性之间取得了微妙的平衡，确保它既不会压倒也不会辜负学生的雄心壮志） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>. However, what truly sets this exam apart </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（让这次考试与众不同的） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>is the fiercely competitive </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（竞争激烈） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>nature of the race for the prestigious title </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（高级头衔） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>of grade-topper, a distinction that has become the subject of fervent speculation and heated debate among students and faculty alike. </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（这一区别已成为学生和教师热烈猜测和激烈辩论的主题。）</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:2.8pt;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:-.75pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;text-indent:27.45pt;line-height:90%><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>In a candid and rather magnanimous statement, Yu Zixuan, the reigning champion of the previous semester, remarked with a blend of humility and determination </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（在一份坦率而相当宽宏大量的声明中，上学期的获奖者谦逊而坚定地表示） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>, “I shall spare no effort in my quest to retain my position at the pinnacle of academic excellence. Nevertheless, it is my sincerest wish that my peers, too, rise to the occasion and unleash their full potential, for it is in the spirit of collective growth and mutual inspiration that true greatness is forged. </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（我将不遗余力地追求保持我在学术上的顶峰。然而，我衷心希望我的同龄人也能迎难而上，充分发挥潜力，因为正是本着集体成长和相互激励的精神，才能铸就真正的伟大。） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>” Such words, dripping with both competitive zeal and altruistic sentiment, have only served to heighten the anticipation surrounding this high-stakes academic showdown. ( </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>这些充满竞争热情和利他主义情绪的话语，只会加剧人们对这场高风险学术决战的期待。 </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>)</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:2.8pt;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:-.75pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;text-indent:27.45pt;line-height:90%><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>Lin Yuqing, a student who has a good result( </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>成绩）， </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>the front-runner </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（最有可能夺得年级第一者） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>,said “The key to achieving good grades is ‘ The conduct of a noble person is to cultivate oneself through tranquility and nurture virtue through frugality. Without indifference, one cannot clarify their aspirations; without serenity, one cannot achieve far-reaching goals. Learning requires calmness, and talent requires learning. Without learning, one cannot broaden their talents; without determination, one cannot accomplish their studies. Indulgence and laziness prevent one from striving diligently, while recklessness and impatience hinder the cultivation of character. As time passes, one's ambitions fade with the days, leading to a withered and fallen state, often disconnected from the world. To sadly dwell in poverty </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>— </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>what can be done then?’ “.( </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>诫子书）</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:2.8pt;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:-.75pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;text-indent:27.45pt;line-height:90%><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>In conclusion, as the countdown to the monthly exam ticks away with relentless inevitability, the air is thick with a palpable sense of urgency, ambition, and, dare I say, a touch of existential dread. Who will emerge victorious in this battle of wits and wills? Only time, that most impartial of arbiters, will tell. </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（总之，随着月考的倒计时不可避免地流逝，空气中弥漫着一种明显的紧迫感、雄心壮志，我敢说，还有一丝存在的恐惧。谁将在这场智慧和意志的较量中获胜？只有时间，最公正的仲裁者，会告诉我们答案。）</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:0;margin-bottom:3.3pt;margin-left:295.85pt><!--[if mso & !supportInlineShapes & supportFields]><span

</v:shape><span style='mso-element:field-end'></span></span><![endif]--></p><h2>关于春游 <span lang=EN-US>……</span></h2><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:32.05pt><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>下周一，吾校将率全体师生，共赴尚湖公园，此地风景如画，山水相映，有 </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>Soil Grass, </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>诚为春游之佳处。此举非徒为游山玩水，实欲使诸生亲近自然，涤荡心灵，舒解课业之劳顿，兼以增进同窗之情谊，凝聚班级之合力。闻校方已悉心筹备，安排诸多户外之乐事，诸如团队之戏、摄影之赛，皆备矣。诸生务必身着轻便之运动服，携适量之饮食，尤须谨记安全之事，勿使乐极生悲，但犹需写游后感，考试成绩犹出。</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:0;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:184.2pt;text-indent:-152.15pt;line-height:135%><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:135%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>愿诸生乘兴而去，尽兴而归，不负春光，不负此行！ </span><span style=font-size:20pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:135%;font-family:华文中宋;mso-bidi-font-family:华文中宋>数学考试惊现双百！</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:135.85pt><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:20pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文中宋;mso-bidi-font-family:华文中宋>—— </span><span style=font-size:20pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文中宋;mso-bidi-font-family:华文中宋>记初一（ <span lang=EN-US>1 </span>）班林雨晴与吕梦琪的满分奇迹 </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>在刚刚结束的数学周测中，初一（ </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>1 </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>）班的林雨晴和吕梦琪以双双满分的优异成绩，成为了全校瞩目的焦点。这场考试不仅是对她们个人能力的肯定，更是一段关于努力、坚持与智慧的美好故事。</span></p><p align=center class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:7.9pt;margin-bottom:0;margin-left:32.3pt;text-align:center;text-indent:-.5pt><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>满分的背后：汗水与坚持</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:32.05pt><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>林雨晴和吕梦琪的满分并非偶然，而是日复一日努力的结果。林雨晴从小就对数学充满兴趣，她喜欢在数字的世界里寻找规律，享受解题过程中的逻辑之美。每天放学后，她都会花一个小时钻研数学题，甚至常常为了一个难题思考到深夜。她的书桌上堆满了草稿纸，每一张都记录着她思维的痕迹。</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:32.05pt><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>吕梦琪则是一个细致入微的女孩。她不仅注重基础知识的掌握，还善于总结解题技巧。她的笔记本上密密麻麻地写满了各种公式和例题，每一页都凝聚着她的心血。她说： </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>“ </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>数学就像一座迷宫，只有找到正确的路径，才能走出困境。 </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>” </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>正是这种对数学的热爱与执着，让她在考试中游刃有余。老师的评价：基础扎实，思维清晰</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:32.05pt><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>Soil Grass </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>对两位同学的表现赞不绝口。说： </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>“ </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>林雨晴和吕梦琪不仅基础扎实，解题思路也非常清晰。她们在考试中展现出的逻辑思维和应变能力，让我感到非常欣慰。 </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>”Soil Grass </span><span revision </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（复习） </span><span lang=EN-US </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（浓厚的） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（学术紧张） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>. This examination, far from being a mere </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（仅仅；极小的） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>routine </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（常规） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>assessment of academic prowess </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（高超的技艺） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>, serves as a profound litmus test of one’s dedication, perseverance, and intellectual fortitude </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（是检验一个人的奉献精神、毅力和智力毅力的深刻试金石） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>. According to an exclusive revelation</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:2.8pt;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:-.75pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;line-height:90%><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（独家爆料） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>from the Academic Affairs Office of the Soil Grass, the difficulty level of this exam has been meticulously calibrated to strike a delicate balance between challenge and feasibility, ensuring that it neither overwhelms nor underwhelms the aspirational spirits of the student body </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（这次考试的难度经过了精心的调整，在挑战性和可行性之间取得了微妙的平衡，确保它既不会压倒也不会辜负学生的雄心壮志） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>. However, what truly sets this exam apart </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（让这次考试与众不同的） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>is the fiercely competitive </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（竞争激烈） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>nature of the race for the prestigious title </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（高级头衔） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>of grade-topper, a distinction that has become the subject of fervent speculation and heated debate among students and faculty alike. </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（这一区别已成为学生和教师热烈猜测和激烈辩论的主题。）</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:2.8pt;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:-.75pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;text-indent:27.45pt;line-height:90%><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>In a candid and rather magnanimous statement, Yu Zixuan, the reigning champion of the previous semester, remarked with a blend of humility and determination </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（在一份坦率而相当宽宏大量的声明中，上学期的获奖者谦逊而坚定地表示） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>, “I shall spare no effort in my quest to retain my position at the pinnacle of academic excellence. Nevertheless, it is my sincerest wish that my peers, too, rise to the occasion and unleash their full potential, for it is in the spirit of collective growth and mutual inspiration that true greatness is forged. </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（我将不遗余力地追求保持我在学术上的顶峰。然而，我衷心希望我的同龄人也能迎难而上，充分发挥潜力，因为正是本着集体成长和相互激励的精神，才能铸就真正的伟大。） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>” Such words, dripping with both competitive zeal and altruistic sentiment, have only served to heighten the anticipation surrounding this high-stakes academic showdown. ( </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>这些充满竞争热情和利他主义情绪的话语，只会加剧人们对这场高风险学术决战的期待。 </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>)</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:2.8pt;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:-.75pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;text-indent:27.45pt;line-height:90%><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>Lin Yuqing, a student who has a good result( </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>成绩）， </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>the front-runner </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（最有可能夺得年级第一者） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>,said “The key to achieving good grades is ‘ The conduct of a noble person is to cultivate oneself through tranquility and nurture virtue through frugality. Without indifference, one cannot clarify their aspirations; without serenity, one cannot achieve far-reaching goals. Learning requires calmness, and talent requires learning. Without learning, one cannot broaden their talents; without determination, one cannot accomplish their studies. Indulgence and laziness prevent one from striving diligently, while recklessness and impatience hinder the cultivation of character. As time passes, one's ambitions fade with the days, leading to a withered and fallen state, often disconnected from the world. To sadly dwell in poverty </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>— </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>what can be done then?’ “.( </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>诫子书）</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:2.8pt;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:-.75pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;text-indent:27.45pt;line-height:90%><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>In conclusion, as the countdown to the monthly exam ticks away with relentless inevitability, the air is thick with a palpable sense of urgency, ambition, and, dare I say, a touch of existential dread. Who will emerge victorious in this battle of wits and wills? Only time, that most impartial of arbiters, will tell. </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（总之，随着月考的倒计时不可避免地流逝，空气中弥漫着一种明显的紧迫感、雄心壮志，我敢说，还有一丝存在的恐惧。谁将在这场智慧和意志的较量中获胜？只有时间，最公正的仲裁者，会告诉我们答案。）</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:0;margin-bottom:3.3pt;margin-left:295.85pt><!--[if mso & !supportInlineShapes & supportFields]><span

style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>下周一，吾校将率全体师生，共赴尚湖公园，此地风景如画，山水相映，有 </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>Soil Grass, </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>诚为春游之佳处。此举非徒为游山玩水，实欲使诸生亲近自然，涤荡心灵，舒解课业之劳顿，兼以增进同窗之情谊，凝聚班级之合力。闻校方已悉心筹备，安排诸多户外之乐事，诸如团队之戏、摄影之赛，皆备矣。诸生务必身着轻便之运动服，携适量之饮食，尤须谨记安全之事，勿使乐极生悲，但犹需写游后感，考试成绩犹出。</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:0;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:184.2pt;text-indent:-152.15pt;line-height:135%><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:135%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>愿诸生乘兴而去，尽兴而归，不负春光，不负此行！ </span><span style=font-size:20pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:135%;font-family:华文中宋;mso-bidi-font-family:华文中宋>数学考试惊现双百！</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:135.85pt><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:20pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文中宋;mso-bidi-font-family:华文中宋>—— </span><span style=font-size:20pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文中宋;mso-bidi-font-family:华文中宋>记初一（ <span lang=EN-US>1 </span>）班林雨晴与吕梦琪的满分奇迹 </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>在刚刚结束的数学周测中，初一（ </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>1 </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>）班的林雨晴和吕梦琪以双双满分的优异成绩，成为了全校瞩目的焦点。这场考试不仅是对她们个人能力的肯定，更是一段关于努力、坚持与智慧的美好故事。</span></p><p align=center class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:7.9pt;margin-bottom:0;margin-left:32.3pt;text-align:center;text-indent:-.5pt><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>满分的背后：汗水与坚持</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:32.05pt><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>林雨晴和吕梦琪的满分并非偶然，而是日复一日努力的结果。林雨晴从小就对数学充满兴趣，她喜欢在数字的世界里寻找规律，享受解题过程中的逻辑之美。每天放学后，她都会花一个小时钻研数学题，甚至常常为了一个难题思考到深夜。她的书桌上堆满了草稿纸，每一张都记录着她思维的痕迹。</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:32.05pt><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>吕梦琪则是一个细致入微的女孩。她不仅注重基础知识的掌握，还善于总结解题技巧。她的笔记本上密密麻麻地写满了各种公式和例题，每一页都凝聚着她的心血。她说： </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>“ </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>数学就像一座迷宫，只有找到正确的路径，才能走出困境。 </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>” </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>正是这种对数学的热爱与执着，让她在考试中游刃有余。老师的评价：基础扎实，思维清晰</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:32.05pt><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>Soil Grass </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>对两位同学的表现赞不绝口。说： </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>“ </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>林雨晴和吕梦琪不仅基础扎实，解题思路也非常清晰。她们在考试中展现出的逻辑思维和应变能力，让我感到非常欣慰。 </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>”Soil Grass </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>的话语中充满了骄傲与期待。他相信，这两位同学的成功不仅是个人的荣耀，更是班级乃至全校的榜样。他鼓励其他同学向她们学习，努力提升自己的数学水平。</span></p><p style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>“ </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>” </span><span style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:32.05pt><span According to an exclusive revelation</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:2.8pt;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:-.75pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;line-height:90%><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（独家爆料） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>from the Academic Affairs Office of the Soil Grass, the difficulty level of this exam has been meticulously calibrated to strike a delicate balance between challenge and feasibility, ensuring that it neither overwhelms nor underwhelms the aspirational spirits of the student body </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（这次考试的难度经过了精心的调整，在挑战性和可行性之间取得了微妙的平衡，确保它既不会压倒也不会辜负学生的雄心壮志） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>. However, what truly sets this exam apart </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（让这次考试与众不同的） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>is the fiercely competitive </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（竞争激烈） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>nature of the race for the prestigious title </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（高级头衔） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>of grade-topper, a distinction that has become the subject of fervent speculation and heated debate among students and faculty alike. </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（这一区别已成为学生和教师热烈猜测和激烈辩论的主题。）</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:2.8pt;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:-.75pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;text-indent:27.45pt;line-height:90%><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>In a candid and rather magnanimous statement, Yu Zixuan, the reigning champion of the previous semester, remarked with a blend of humility and determination </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（在一份坦率而相当宽宏大量的声明中，上学期的获奖者谦逊而坚定地表示） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>, “I shall spare no effort in my quest to retain my position at the pinnacle of academic excellence. Nevertheless, it is my sincerest wish that my peers, too, rise to the occasion and unleash their full potential, for it is in the spirit of collective growth and mutual inspiration that true greatness is forged. </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（我将不遗余力地追求保持我在学术上的顶峰。然而，我衷心希望我的同龄人也能迎难而上，充分发挥潜力，因为正是本着集体成长和相互激励的精神，才能铸就真正的伟大。） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>” Such words, dripping with both competitive zeal and altruistic sentiment, have only served to heighten the anticipation surrounding this high-stakes academic showdown. ( </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>这些充满竞争热情和利他主义情绪的话语，只会加剧人们对这场高风险学术决战的期待。 </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>)</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:2.8pt;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:-.75pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;text-indent:27.45pt;line-height:90%><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>Lin Yuqing, a student who has a good result( </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>成绩）， </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>the front-runner </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（最有可能夺得年级第一者） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>,said “The key to achieving good grades is ‘ The conduct of a noble person is to cultivate oneself through tranquility and nurture virtue through frugality. Without indifference, one cannot clarify their aspirations; without serenity, one cannot achieve far-reaching goals. Learning requires calmness, and talent requires learning. Without learning, one cannot broaden their talents; without determination, one cannot accomplish their studies. Indulgence and laziness prevent one from striving diligently, while recklessness and impatience hinder the cultivation of character. As time passes, one's ambitions fade with the days, leading to a withered and fallen state, often disconnected from the world. To sadly dwell in poverty </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>— </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>what can be done then?’ “.( </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>诫子书）</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:2.8pt;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:-.75pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;text-indent:27.45pt;line-height:90%><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>In conclusion, as the countdown to the monthly exam ticks away with relentless inevitability, the air is thick with a palpable sense of urgency, ambition, and, dare I say, a touch of existential dread. Who will emerge victorious in this battle of wits and wills? Only time, that most impartial of arbiters, will tell. </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（总之，随着月考的倒计时不可避免地流逝，空气中弥漫着一种明显的紧迫感、雄心壮志，我敢说，还有一丝存在的恐惧。谁将在这场智慧和意志的较量中获胜？只有时间，最公正的仲裁者，会告诉我们答案。）</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:0;margin-bottom:3.3pt;margin-left:295.85pt><!--[if mso & !supportInlineShapes & supportFields]><span

</v:shape><span style='mso-element:field-end'></span></span><![endif]--></p><h2>关于春游 <span lang=EN-US>……</span></h2><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:32.05pt><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>下周一，吾校将率全体师生，共赴尚湖公园，此地风景如画，山水相映，有 </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>Soil Grass, </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>诚为春游之佳处。此举非徒为游山玩水，实欲使诸生亲近自然，涤荡心灵，舒解课业之劳顿，兼以增进同窗之情谊，凝聚班级之合力。闻校方已悉心筹备，安排诸多户外之乐事，诸如团队之戏、摄影之赛，皆备矣。诸生务必身着轻便之运动服，携适量之饮食，尤须谨记安全之事，勿使乐极生悲，但犹需写游后感，考试成绩犹出。</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:0;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:184.2pt;text-indent:-152.15pt;line-height:135%><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:135%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>愿诸生乘兴而去，尽兴而归，不负春光，不负此行！ </span><span style=font-size:20pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:135%;font-family:华文中宋;mso-bidi-font-family:华文中宋>数学考试惊现双百！</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:135.85pt><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:20pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文中宋;mso-bidi-font-family:华文中宋>—— </span><span style=font-size:20pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文中宋;mso-bidi-font-family:华文中宋>记初一（ <span lang=EN-US>1 </span>）班林雨晴与吕梦琪的满分奇迹 </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>在刚刚结束的数学周测中，初一（ </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>1 </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>）班的林雨晴和吕梦琪以双双满分的优异成绩，成为了全校瞩目的焦点。这场考试不仅是对她们个人能力的肯定，更是一段关于努力、坚持与智慧的美好故事。</span></p><p align=center class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:7.9pt;margin-bottom:0;margin-left:32.3pt;text-align:center;text-indent:-.5pt><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>满分的背后：汗水与坚持</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:32.05pt><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>林雨晴和吕梦琪的满分并非偶然，而是日复一日努力的结果。林雨晴从小就对数学充满兴趣，她喜欢在数字的世界里寻找规律，享受解题过程中的逻辑之美。每天放学后，她都会花一个小时钻研数学题，甚至常常为了一个难题思考到深夜。她的书桌上堆满了草稿纸，每一张都记录着她思维的痕迹。</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:32.05pt><span style=font-size:18pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>the Coveted </span><span style=font-size:18pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（令人垂涎的） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:18pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>Title </span><span style=font-size:18pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（称号） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:18pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>of Grade-Topper?</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:0;text-indent:27.95pt;line-height:90%><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>As the first monthly examination of the semester </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（半学年） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>looms ominously </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（不详地赫然出现） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>on the horizon </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（范围） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>, students across all grade levels have plunged themselves into </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（热情投入） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>an intense </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（紧张激烈的） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>and nerve-wracking phase </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（阶段） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>of revision </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（复习） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>, characterized by </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（表现为） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>sleepless nights, endless cups of coffee, and an atmosphere </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（气氛） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>thick </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（浓厚的） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>with academic tension </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（学术紧张） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>. This examination, far from being a mere </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（仅仅；极小的） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>routine </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（常规） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>assessment of academic prowess </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（高超的技艺） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>, serves as a profound litmus test of one’s dedication, perseverance, and intellectual fortitude </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（是检验一个人的奉献精神、毅力和智力毅力的深刻试金石） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>. According to an exclusive revelation</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:2.8pt;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:-.75pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;line-height:90%><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（独家爆料） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>from the Academic Affairs Office of the Soil Grass, the difficulty level of this exam has been meticulously calibrated to strike a delicate balance between challenge and feasibility, ensuring that it neither overwhelms nor underwhelms the aspirational spirits of the student body </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（这次考试的难度经过了精心的调整，在挑战性和可行性之间取得了微妙的平衡，确保它既不会压倒也不会辜负学生的雄心壮志） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>. However, what truly sets this exam apart </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（让这次考试与众不同的） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>is the fiercely competitive </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（竞争激烈） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>nature of the race for the prestigious title </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（高级头衔） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>of grade-topper, a distinction that has become the subject of fervent speculation and heated debate among students and faculty alike. </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（这一区别已成为学生和教师热烈猜测和激烈辩论的主题。）</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:2.8pt;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:-.75pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;text-indent:27.45pt;line-height:90%><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>In a candid and rather magnanimous statement, Yu Zixuan, the reigning champion of the previous semester, remarked with a blend of humility and determination </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（在一份坦率而相当宽宏大量的声明中，上学期的获奖者谦逊而坚定地表示） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>, “I shall spare no effort in my quest to retain my position at the pinnacle of academic excellence. Nevertheless, it is my sincerest wish that my peers, too, rise to the occasion and unleash their full potential, for it is in the spirit of collective growth and mutual inspiration that true greatness is forged. </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（我将不遗余力地追求保持我在学术上的顶峰。然而，我衷心希望我的同龄人也能迎难而上，充分发挥潜力，因为正是本着集体成长和相互激励的精神，才能铸就真正的伟大。） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>” Such words, dripping with both competitive zeal and altruistic sentiment, have only served to heighten the anticipation surrounding this high-stakes academic showdown. ( </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>这些充满竞争热情和利他主义情绪的话语，只会加剧人们对这场高风险学术决战的期待。 </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>)</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:2.8pt;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:-.75pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;text-indent:27.45pt;line-height:90%><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>Lin Yuqing, a student who has a good result( </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>成绩）， </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>the front-runner </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（最有可能夺得年级第一者） </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>,said “The key to achieving good grades is ‘ The conduct of a noble person is to cultivate oneself through tranquility and nurture virtue through frugality. Without indifference, one cannot clarify their aspirations; without serenity, one cannot achieve far-reaching goals. Learning requires calmness, and talent requires learning. Without learning, one cannot broaden their talents; without determination, one cannot accomplish their studies. Indulgence and laziness prevent one from striving diligently, while recklessness and impatience hinder the cultivation of character. As time passes, one's ambitions fade with the days, leading to a withered and fallen state, often disconnected from the world. To sadly dwell in poverty </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>— </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>what can be done then?’ “.( </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>诫子书）</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:2.8pt;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:-.75pt;text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;text-indent:27.45pt;line-height:90%><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%>In conclusion, as the countdown to the monthly exam ticks away with relentless inevitability, the air is thick with a palpable sense of urgency, ambition, and, dare I say, a touch of existential dread. Who will emerge victorious in this battle of wits and wills? Only time, that most impartial of arbiters, will tell. </span><span style=font-size:14pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:90%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>（总之，随着月考的倒计时不可避免地流逝，空气中弥漫着一种明显的紧迫感、雄心壮志，我敢说，还有一丝存在的恐惧。谁将在这场智慧和意志的较量中获胜？只有时间，最公正的仲裁者，会告诉我们答案。）</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:0;margin-bottom:3.3pt;margin-left:295.85pt><!--[if mso & !supportInlineShapes & supportFields]><span

</v:shape><span style='mso-element:field-end'></span></span><![endif]--></p><h2>关于春游 <span lang=EN-US>……</span></h2><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:32.05pt><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>下周一，吾校将率全体师生，共赴尚湖公园，此地风景如画，山水相映，有 </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>Soil Grass, </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>诚为春游之佳处。此举非徒为游山玩水，实欲使诸生亲近自然，涤荡心灵，舒解课业之劳顿，兼以增进同窗之情谊，凝聚班级之合力。闻校方已悉心筹备，安排诸多户外之乐事，诸如团队之戏、摄影之赛，皆备矣。诸生务必身着轻便之运动服，携适量之饮食，尤须谨记安全之事，勿使乐极生悲，但犹需写游后感，考试成绩犹出。</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:0;margin-bottom:.15pt;margin-left:184.2pt;text-indent:-152.15pt;line-height:135%><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:135%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>愿诸生乘兴而去，尽兴而归，不负春光，不负此行！ </span><span style=font-size:20pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:135%;font-family:华文中宋;mso-bidi-font-family:华文中宋>数学考试惊现双百！</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:135.85pt><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:20pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文中宋;mso-bidi-font-family:华文中宋>—— </span><span style=font-size:20pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文中宋;mso-bidi-font-family:华文中宋>记初一（ <span lang=EN-US>1 </span>）班林雨晴与吕梦琪的满分奇迹 </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>在刚刚结束的数学周测中，初一（ </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>1 </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>）班的林雨晴和吕梦琪以双双满分的优异成绩，成为了全校瞩目的焦点。这场考试不仅是对她们个人能力的肯定，更是一段关于努力、坚持与智慧的美好故事。</span></p><p align=center class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:7.9pt;margin-bottom:0;margin-left:32.3pt;text-align:center;text-indent:-.5pt><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>满分的背后：汗水与坚持</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:32.05pt><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>林雨晴和吕梦琪的满分并非偶然，而是日复一日努力的结果。林雨晴从小就对数学充满兴趣，她喜欢在数字的世界里寻找规律，享受解题过程中的逻辑之美。每天放学后，她都会花一个小时钻研数学题，甚至常常为了一个难题思考到深夜。她的书桌上堆满了草稿纸，每一张都记录着她思维的痕迹。</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:32.05pt><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>吕梦琪则是一个细致入微的女孩。她不仅注重基础知识的掌握，还善于总结解题技巧。她的笔记本上密密麻麻地写满了各种公式和例题，每一页都凝聚着她的心血。她说： </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>“ </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>数学就像一座迷宫，只有找到正确的路径，才能走出困境。 </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>” </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>正是这种对数学的热爱与执着，让她在考试中游刃有余。老师的评价：基础扎实，思维清晰</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:32.05pt><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>Soil Grass </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>对两位同学的表现赞不绝口。说： </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>“ </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>林雨晴和吕梦琪不仅基础扎实，解题思路也非常清晰。她们在考试中展现出的逻辑思维和应变能力，让我感到非常欣慰。 </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>”Soil Grass </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>还特别提到，林雨晴在几何题中展现出的空间想象力令人惊叹，而吕梦琪在代数题中的计算速度和准确性更是无人能及。</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:32.05pt><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>Soil Grass </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>的话语中充满了骄傲与期待。他相信，这两位同学的成功不仅是个人的荣耀，更是班级乃至全校的榜样。他鼓励其他同学向她们学习，努力提升自己的数学水平。</span></p><p align=center class=MsoNormal style=margin-top:0;margin-right:7.8pt;margin-bottom:0;margin-left:32.3pt;text-align:center;text-indent:-.5pt><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>林雨晴的谦逊：努力永无止境</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:32.05pt><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>面对满分的成绩，林雨晴表现得非常谦逊。她说： </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>“ </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>这次考试题目比较适合我，我会继续努力。 </span><span lang=EN-US style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%>” </span><span style=font-size:16pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:华文楷体;mso-bidi-font-family:华文楷体>在她看来，满分只是一个新的起点，而不是终点。她计划在接下来的学习中，进一步挑战更高难度的题目，并尝试参加数学竞赛，以检验自己的实力。</span></p><p class=MsoNormal style=margin-bottom:.15pt;text-indent:32.05pt><span
